_comment: ag3s-verifier (CL-analysis, Opus). numbers and paths only. CPU re-analysis of the recorded CL raw; no server, no GPU.

runs.command: outputs/verify/T44/CLA/p/field_scan.py <C1b, C2 names> (recorded float16 grids, coarse ON vs OFF)

definitions.field_requery_check: recorded TO worst rows reproduced from the recorded float16 grids + FK: C1b_ep12_s122 seq 16/48/49/52 -> 9.30/1.88/-7.18/3.65 mm (d-r) vs recorded -0.7/-8.1/-7.18/-6.38 mm = same within fp16 after the 10 mm obstacle margin (0 margin on the seq-49 row)
definitions.fk_check: constraint sphere model rebuilt (links gripper, capsule_radius_scale 0.05, sphere_spacing 0.4, max 32, finger cover both): FK at reference row 0 vs recorded sphere_centres max 4.3e-7 m
definitions.coarse_OFF: same recorded fine target-free / main layers, target_free_coarse_layer=None (= C1a composition) on the C1b grids
definitions.approach_chunks: last 4 planning chunks before the first close command (replay grip_cmd < 0.5)
definitions.dz7: z of the active-finger sphere mean, refined - reference, chunk row 7
definitions.dz_c8: replay finger_mid - target body origin, z, 8 control rows after the first close
definitions.zero_level: lowest z >= support plane with target-free distance > 0, minus support z
definitions.GT_gap: signed distance to the convex hull of the fruit's MuJoCo collision meshes (facet max) minus sphere radius
definitions.first_material: first seq with max |refined C1a - refined C1b| (rows 0..7, arm cols) > 0.01 rad

support_zero_level_above_plane_mm.definition: per slice column x: lowest z >= support plane where the target-free distance > 0, minus support z; median over columns

scene_chunk.note: the slice passes through the worst finger sphere (y0), beside the target; the GT target hull is not cut by this plane unless an orange contour shows

Q2_C2.sphere_links: ee_finger_* 56 x4, ee_left/right 23, link_*_arm_6 29, arm_1 11, arm_5 10, arm_3 9, arm_4 8, arm_2 5, arm_0 4 (per side)
Q2_C2.margin_source: ag3s/constraints/clearance.py:261 margin_matrix (unauthorized links keep full_margin for TARGET) via constraints/to_adapter.py:201 manipulated_link_margin
Q2_C2.example_run: C2_ep12_s122 seq 12-15: worst row link_left_arm_5 (fine, target), push7 11.2/31.5/15.0/0.0 mm, HOLD seq 14-17

Q4_contacts.sphere_model_palm: ee_left/right spheres 6.2 mm vs URDF capsule 33.0 mm (server log: 27.3 mm short)

baseline_check.note: regression-baseline not run: this step re-reads recorded CL raw on CPU only (no code executed against the live pipeline); field re-query and FK checked against recorded values (definitions.field_requery_check, fk_check)

verdict.Q1: coarse tier implicated (support surface zero level 0 -> 11.5 mm under ball, 4 -> 9 mm outside ball; worst approach row tier target_free_coarse 50/72 chunks; TO lift median 2.0 vs 0.0 mm; C1b grasp height +1.7..+26.4 mm vs C1a in 7/7 pairs). HOLD at the first divergence: 0/7.
verdict.Q2: permission mask not empty (135 rows). link_*_arm_5 is the worst TO row in 153 chunks / 17 runs with implied target margin 50 mm; C2 also carries the C1b coarse support lift (zero level 11.0 / 9.0 mm).
verdict.Q3: C1a close-time HOLD in 14 runs / 15 chunks (C0 1): authorized finger, target_free tier, grasp state closing, nearest kept seed ambiguous in 14/15; split fired 0; strict 2 chunks.
verdict.Q4: C1a pre-release events: palm (EE_BODY) 3 events with distractor kept in field (0.91-0.93) and sphere-model gap 9-16 mm actual; finger-banana 5 events with 0.35-0.47 of banana vertices in field (main field same).

not_measured: mesh-level hand geometry in the TO prediction (sphere model only); palm contact explanation rests on the sphere-model radius shortfall from the server log
support-seed-free coarse tier or fine-unobserved-only coarse (fix candidates) not run
C1a vs C1b with the same state (counterfactual closed loop) not run; per-pair attribution is observational
GT gaps use convex hulls of collision meshes (outside distances are lower bounds)
only the worst authorized row per chunk is located for the per-chunk location stats; row-level distributions only via lower_loc medians
